capabilities: Replace the Daily Note tab icon with a yellow star
Follow Daily Notes core plugin folder and date-format settings
Update the icon after file changes and at midnight
extras: Desktop only (Obsidian 1.4.0+); today's Daily Note must already exist. Uses a guarded DOM reference to the tab header because there is no public API, so it may silently stop working after Obsidian updates. The manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: replaces the document icon in today's Daily Note tab with a solid yellow star
problem: Obsidian offers no way to visually distinguish the tab for today's Daily Note from other open tabs.

relations.evidence: The plugin follows the folder and date format configured in the Daily Notes core plugin

summary: Cosmetic plugin that replaces the document icon on today's Daily Note tab with a solid yellow star.
